% Reference behavior for macro scoping and label placement; see
% docs/design.md. Compile outside the repository with
%   pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -no-shell-escape scoping.tex
% then compare the RESULT lines in the log and the \newlabel lines in the .aux
% file with the expectations below.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
% A definition inside an explicit preamble group stays local.
{\newcommand{\grouped}{x}}
% A global assignment inside a group survives the group.
\def\x{a}{\gdef\x{b}}
% Including after a local assignment to the same name in that group.
\def\y{a}{\def\y{c}\gdef\y{b}}
\begin{document}
\setcounter{section}{6}
\section{Seven}
\setcounter{equation}{40}
% A label on an unnumbered row binds to the next numbered row: 41.
\begin{align}
a &= b \notag \label{pending} \\
c &= d
\end{align}
% A label on a final unnumbered row stays undefined: no \newlabel.
\begin{align}
e &= f \\
g &= h \notag \label{trailing}
\end{align}
% A label in an unnumbered environment binds to the current label, which
% LaTeX sets locally: the section (7), not the equations numbered above.
\begin{equation*}
k = l \label{starred}
\end{equation*}
\typeout{RESULT x=\x}% b
\typeout{RESULT y=\y}% b
\ifdefined\grouped \typeout{RESULT grouped=defined}%
\else \typeout{RESULT grouped=undefined}\fi% undefined
\end{document}
